bio_en: Tigran G. Kharputlian was born in Bakr Maden near Diyarbekir on 12 April 1880 and moved to Kharpert at the age of ten, where he witnessed the massacres. A carpenter by trade, he emigrated to America in 1891 and lived there for some years in a patriotic milieu. In early 1904 he left for the Persian-Ottoman border to join the bands helping Sasun and entered Duman's cavalry, which on 28 June 1904 tried to break into Vaspurakan via Khanasor. On 24 October 1904 he joined Pokhik's 15-man armed band and was killed with it.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Text says he emigrated 'at the start of 1891' at about age ten-eleven - dates as given.
